audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven chart rows disagreed with both the packet and the page's own whys, which open with the words 'Riven owns Level 1', 'It is genuinely even at 2', 'Level 6 is even' and 'After 2+ lethality items Riven reclaims it' — while the chart handed Heimerdinger levels 1, 2, 6 and the 2-item row. report[14] also called it 'Tricky' where diff says EVEN.
audit.why: Packet chart is [Riven, Skill, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Skill, Heimerdinger, Riven] at exactly 50% over 138 games. The prose is unusually precise here and already matches it row for row.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 -> Riven, 1 -> Skill, 3 -> Heimerdinger, 4 -> Skill, 5 -> Heimerdinger, 6 -> Riven in both layers with matched ratings; report[14].t now says Even.

audit.why: Four spikes and the late-game inversion is stated honestly: her two-lethality-item spike beats the nest, so the lane must be cashed at 4-5 and first item. That is the correct win condition for this matchup.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns described Ki Burst as 'Her engage CC' with no number, no range, and nothing about Broken Wings or Valor.
audit.why: Ki Burst is 11/10/9/8/7s at only 260 range — she has to be on top of you for it, which is exactly what your nest is meant to prevent. Broken Wings is 13s for the whole three-cast sequence, so a spent combo is a genuinely long window. Valor is a 10s shield-dash, which is what eats your burst if you fire it early. Those three numbers are the entire sequencing plan and none were on the page.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rebuilt around the three real cooldowns plus Ki Burst's 260 range; dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[1].d carry the Ki Burst and Valor windows.

edits.before: One turret + AA wins level 1 against almost everyone. Identify how Riven contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: One turret, no grenade — her Q-dash mobility and Runic Blade autos own the only contact window that exists at level 1.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Ki Burst's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Yours: three charges plus the center-stun make her all-in suicidal — land the stun and three beams beat her 10s Valor shield.

edits.before: Upgraded E or W deletes his all-in — choose per fight. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Riven's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Even: UPGRADE!!! spikes your zone exactly as Blade of the Exile lands, and her dash-burst still answers an immobile yordle.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Riven carry threat 8/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two lethality items and she dashes through the zone and one-shots you through a landed grenade. Close it before this.

edits.before: Tricky matchup — difficulty 7.5/10, Riven carry threat 8/10.
edits.after: Even matchup — difficulty 7.5/10, Riven carry threat 8/10.

edits.before: - Riven Ki Burst: matchup-defining — Her engage CC. E-stun her first. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ki Burst: 11s at rank 1 and only 260 range — she has to be on top of you to use it. - Broken Wings: 13s for all three casts, so a spent combo is a long walk. - Valor: 10s shield-dash. - Your grenade: 11s.

edits.before: Riven wastes Ki Burst (Stun) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Her Ki Burst spent is 11s at rank 1 with no stun to answer you.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Valor blocks damage on a 10s dash — bait it out before your burst.

notes: The prose on this matchup is already at the quality bar — it names Broken Wings' three casts, Runic Blade, Valor's shield-dash and Blade of the Exile correctly, and it is honest that the lane inverts at two lethality items. The only real defect was the level chart, which contradicted its own whys on six of seven rows. Not asserted (kit is silent): whether Valor's damage block absorbs your turret beams individually or as one instance, and whether the grenade's centre stun can be dodged by the dash frames of Broken Wings — the page already warns about clipping her with only the outer slow, which is supported by Riot's 'directly hit' wording, so I left that alone.
